seo.title: Texoma Water Taxi by Fastrac — On-Demand Rides to the Islands, Marinas & Your Dock
seo.description: It's like Uber on the water. $25 per person each way between Highport Marina and the islands, $100 an hour private for up to six, pickups at any marina or dock in the service area, sunrise to sunset. Text 903.414.6050.

heroImage.alt: Water taxi underway on Lake Texoma

home.heroTitle: It's like Uber. On the water.
home.heroSubtitle: A ride to the islands, a restaurant, another marina or back to your own dock — without the swim. Text or call and we'll get you there.

intro.title: Where do you want to go?
body: The Texoma Water Taxi runs on demand from sunrise to sunset across the busiest part of Lake Texoma: Highport Marina and Island Bar & Grill, Pelican's Landing, Marina Del Rey, Flowing Wells, Grandpappy Point, Buncombe Creek, Alberta Creek, Catfish Bay, Burns Run, Island View, Lighthouse Resort and the islands — North (Party) Island, Treasure Island and Wood Island.

We'll pick you up at any marina or at your dock inside the service area, drop you at your boat, run beverages out to the island, or take the whole crew to dinner and bring you home. Groups up to 18 on the Mellow Yellow; six on the Jolt.

features.title: Island shuttle
features.body: $25 per person each way between Highport Marina and North, Treasure or Wood Island. All ages, sunrise to sunset. Round trips are two bookings.

features.title: Anywhere on the lake
features.body: $100 an hour dock-to-dock for up to six, from the time we leave our dock until we return. Restaurants, marinas, your friend's slip.

features.title: Boat drop-off & pickup
features.body: Left the boat at the marina and the truck at the ramp? We'll shuttle you between them, or out to your boat on the hook.

features.title: Overnight island camping
features.body: Drop-off in the afternoon, pickup in the morning. Bring everything — the islands are primitive.

features.title: Beverage delivery
features.body: Running low on the island? We'll bring ice and drinks from the store out to you.

features.title: Parties & celebrations
features.body: Bachelor and bachelorette parties, wedding shuttles, birthdays — the Mellow Yellow carries 18, or step up to a Fastrac private charter.

reviews.quote: Texted from Highport, boat showed up in 20 minutes, dropped us on Party Island. Exactly as advertised.
reviews.author: Fourth of July crew

reviews.quote: Took the taxi to dinner at Pelican's Landing and back to our slip. Way better than driving.

hubHandoff.title: Text for a ride, or book ahead
hubHandoff.body: For a ride right now, text 903.414.6050 or call 903.361.0775. For a set pickup time, holiday weekends or groups, book online — and if you'd rather have the whole boat for the evening, Fastrac's charters and cruises leave from the same dock.

plan.title: Routes, rates & how it works
plan.subtitle: Service area centered on Highport Marina and the Preston Peninsula; home dock at Lighthouse Marina.

arrival.title: How to get a ride
body: Text 903.414.6050 or call 903.361.0775 with where you are and where you're headed. For a guaranteed pickup time — holiday weekends especially — book online ahead. Your captain takes card, Venmo or cash on the boat; tips appreciated.
Rides run rain or shine, sunrise to sunset; night trips can be arranged with a $20 surcharge. Memorial Day, Fourth of July and Labor Day weekends add $5 per person.
